title: Signature Quanta App: Thought Compiler
description: Manon's original Thought Compiler concept: a quanta app that takes a loosely-worded goal and compiles it into an ordered plan by running many candidate decompositions in superposition-inspired parallel search, then collapsing to the highest-scoring plan.
